LibreBoot: The only free alternative for booting a free computer

It is currently the only fully free alternative for booting your computer or laptop. There are several computers, some servers and a few laptops that are supported.

The project developers deliberately restrict themselves to hardware that can be run without any binary blobs or proprietary software.

MiniFree make free computers available and proceeds from sales help contribute to the LibreBoot Project, which we should all try and support.
